subject: [PATCH 07/16] selftests/mm: cover a shared-source collapse write race

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file, which exercises the requirement that Copy-on-Write (CoW) keeps a shared source isolated from the collapsing side throughout the collapse, even under an actively writing co-sharer. The test case checks that the collapsing child sees the pre-fork content and the writing parent only its own writes. The patch passes on the unmodified kernel and pinpoints the CoW-isolation contract provided by khugepaged collapse.
